title: Is anyone else starting to see this with ASC campaigns on Meta? #meta...
description: Is anyone else starting to see this with ASC campaigns on Meta? #metaads #facebookads #fbads
transcript: Wanna give you guys an update because I'm using ASC campaigns right now, advantage shopping campaigns, and they're actually working really well. So it is essentially just a open, broad campaign that is using campaign budget optimization. And on that ad set I have around 15 creatives. And I just wanna show you the topline metrics over the last 30 days here. So you can see we had a reach of a million people, which is pretty strong, but the frequency is 4 x. So it is naturally retargeting people inside of this campaign. And then just to give you further context, I have other campaigns running, which I've hidden here, but I basically have a top of funnel campaign running with exclusions of those who have engaged with ads and have also visited the website of this brand. And then I have another campaign which is retargeting existing customers, retargets traffic and retargets engagement. And this is the dominant campaign in terms of the ad spend. You can see we've had 4,300 purchases here. We are using whatever creatives have performed well, either organically or on a standard top of funnel campaign. So usually in this account, if we've been testing an ad set that's had 20 or more conversions at a reasonable cost or better cost than average, we then duplicate that ad and run it inside of this ASC. This is the only brand I'm trying this with right now. Usually this brand are paying around $25 Per conversion. Right now it's at $18, and it could come down further by optimizing the creative. Now, if you see my other videos, you'll know that I wasn't actually a fan of ASC for a while. I stopped using it because I found a lot of evidence that supported that these were no longer reliable. But in this scenario, we have been pushing hard on a top of funnel campaign that is getting a lot of new traffic. So I don't feel as worried about this reach to frequency ratio. And it seems to be performing pretty well. I've actually been running this for quite a while. You can see we've had 21,000 purchases lifetime, a X frequency lifetime $17 65 CPA with almost $400,000 of spend. So I would recommend trying out an ASC campaign, especially if you are an e commerce and you have multiple skews and multiple creatives. I would probably only do this when you already have a top funnel and bottom funnel structure and then add this on top. You've got to keep an eye on this frequency. You've got to watch out for auction overlap. But as you can see, there is a lot of data here and in triple well that supports that this campaign is working, and I'm gonna work to keep scaling this.
